name: Azure Terraform Dev
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget unzip curl gnupg lsb-release software-properties-common && wget -q https://releases.hashicorp.com/terraform/1.13.0/terraform_1.13.0_linux_amd64.zip && unzip -o terraform_1.13.0_linux_amd64.zip && sudo mv terraform /usr/local/bin/ && rm terraform_1.13.0_linux_amd64.zip && curl -sL https://aka.ms/InstallAzureCLIDeb | sudo bash
